summary: The wait for the first word is what people notice. You see a provider stream with a pretend server, add stream methods to your clients, send the pieces as server-sent events from FastAPI, see what happens when a stream breaks without handling (status 200 and a cut connection), and write a terminal client.
goal: Stream an answer piece by piece from your endpoint to the terminal, and signal a failure in the middle.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then guess the hook
Step 1: run stream_mock.py and match the six pieces and the last line
Step 2: add the stream methods and the route, then match the curl -N output
Step 3: add a sleep to the fake stream and watch the pieces arrive with and without curl -N
Step 4: raise an error inside a generator without a try, and read the status, the end of the stream and the log
Step 5: write stream_client.py, add three tests and commit
Play the Stream Watcher game to the end and see your score
